  struct Payload
    field active: Boolean
    field value: Int
  enum Reply<T>
    Item(T)
    Empty
  fun describe(value: Reply<Payload>): String
    =
      WhenExpression
        Var value
        arm Item(Payload{active: true, value: number}) if <guard>
          StringLiteral "large"
        arm Item(Payload{active: true, ..})
          StringLiteral "small"
        arm Item(Payload{active: false, ..})
          StringLiteral "inactive"
        arm Empty
          StringLiteral "empty"
  fun main()
    Call println
      Call describe
        MethodCall Item
          Var Reply
          Call Payload
            BoolLiteral true
            IntLiteral 12
    Call println
      Call describe
        MethodCall Item
          Var Reply
          Call Payload
            BoolLiteral true
            IntLiteral 2
    Call println
      Call describe
        MethodCall Item
          Var Reply
          Call Payload
            BoolLiteral false
            IntLiteral 12
    Call println
      Call describe
        FieldAccess Empty
          Var Reply
    val choice: Option<(Boolean, String)>
      Call Some
        TupleLiteral
          BoolLiteral true
          StringLiteral "nested"
    when
      Var choice
      arm Some((true, text))
        Call println
          Var text
      arm Some((false, _))
        Call println
          StringLiteral "false"
      arm None
        Call println
          StringLiteral "none"
